corrections.reason: In Ge'ez plural of እግዚእ (master/leader) is አግዐዚ (masters/leaders of thousands). Visually, the first character is 1st-order አ (without the central loop of 6th-order እ).
In Classical Ge'ez construct state ('unto ages of ages'), the printed text clearly shows 1st-order መ in ለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም ። rather than 6th-order ም.
